content.title: Gary Woodland’s Wife Makes Incredible Sacrifice to Support Him at Houston Open
content.text: Getty HOUSTON, TEXAS - MARCH 28: Gary Woodland of the United States plays a shot from the eighth tee during the third round of the Texas Children's Houston Open 2026 at Memorial Park Golf Course on March 28, 2026 in Houston, Texas. (Photo by Jordan Bank/Getty Images) When professional golfer Gary Woodland faced one of the most daunting challenges of his life upon undergoing brain surgery just a handful of years ago in 2023, it wasn’t just his own resilience that carried him through and saw him successfully recover as he climbed to the top of the global stage for golf. Instead, it was the incredible and shocking sacrifices his wife, Gabby Granado, made to support him that contributed to his rehab back to peak healthy condition. Now, as Gary Woodland competes in the 2026 Texas Children’s Houston Open, Gabby is right by his side once again as she continues to sacrifice in her support of him. Here’s what to know about Gabby Granado’s selflessness and adoration for her husband that has inspired his comeback to the top of the golf world. Gabby Granado Never Left Gary Woodland’s Side As He Navigated the Life-Changing Experience of Brain Surgery GettyST LOUIS, MO – AUGUST 10: Gabby Granado, wife of Gary Woodland of the United States ,, looks on during the second round of the 2018 PGA Championship at Bellerive Country Club on August 10, 2018 in St Louis, Missouri. (Photo by Sam Greenwood/Getty Images) Gabby Granado’s unwavering support for her husband, if often understated, is a crucial part of his journey and path to the Houston Open and throughout his life, career, and medical undertakings to preserve his health. In 2023, after dealing with symptoms that went far beyond the pressures of professional golf, Woodland found himself overwhelmed by months of living with insurmountable anxiety, tremors, and troubling thoughts that saw him ultimately reveal a lesion on his brain which required surgical intervention.The moment brought uncertainty not only to his career, but more pertinently to his life and survival. It was Gabby who made certain that he not only survived, but has been able to thrive ever since. The Sacrifices Made by Gary Woodland’s Wife Not Only Support His Success in Golf, but Have Also Aided in His Survival GettyUS team players Gary Woodland (2nd L) and his girlfriend Gabby Granado (L) with playing partner Matt Kuchar (2nd R) and his wife Sybi Kuchar (R) celebrate with the winners trophy after their victory in the 56th World Cup of Golf tournament at the Mission Hills golf course in Haikou, Hainan Island on November 27, 2011. The US team finished at 24 under par with equal second place going to England and Germany. AFP PHOTO/Mark RALSTON (Photo by MARK RALSTON / AFP via Getty Images) Best known for winning the U.S. Open, Gary Woodland has long been admired for his mental toughness on the course. But it’s the vulnerability in his personal life away from the golf course that often goes overlooked despite its significance in aiding him on his journey to the Texas Children’s Houston Open. Also overlooked and understated in his storyline are the sacrifices Gabby Granado has made to assist Woodland through the extreme hurdles he’s faced off the greens. As Gary prepared for surgery, it was Gabby who took on the emotional weight of the situation with a remarkable display of strength and a foundation of exceptional faith which she maintained as her husband underwent the experience on the operating table and the long, exhausting road to recovery which followed. Present by Gary’s side during every step of the journey – from a plethora of doctors’ appointments and consultations with medical specialists to the undertakings of post-surgical rehabilitation and the extremity of the emotional highs and lows which come with a life-threatening health crisis – Gabby saw their family through to the other side. In many ways, her role in the golfer’s life has gone beyond that of a supportive spouse to that of a lifeline in the face of such a severe health diagnosis. The professional golfer underwent a successful brain surgery followed by the harrowing process of physical, psychological, and emotional recovery. Given that the physical and mental rehabilitation after such a serious operation is even more grueling than the surgery itself, family members are frequently tasked with taking on the burden of weight to see the patients through to successful healing. Caregivers in such situations often have to place their own lives on hold while they sacrifice their time, energy, and expenses to be physically and emotionally present for their loved ones, and Gabby Granado’s sacrifices haven’t been an exception. Gabby She stood by her husband the entire time, and her own resilience may inarguably even outmatch that of what the world has witnessed from Gary’s perseverance in the spotlight. Gary Woodland May Not Be on Top of the Golf World – Nor at the Houston Open at All – Without Gabby Granado’s Support GettyGary Woodland and his wife Gabby Granado Woodland have been through a lot. As Gary Woodland continues to strive for excellence on the golf course at the 2026 Texas Children’s Houston Open this weekend, his wife is standing on the sidelines quietly watching him achieve his dreams and cheering him on in the sport he loves so dearly. Of course, the love he has for his wife is significantly more abounding – as is his gratitude for all of the sacrifices she has made to support him along the harrowing and daunting road of his medical recovery. Through everything Woodland has undergone and endured both on and off of the golf course, Gabby Granado has been his anchor. Without her love and support – both physical caregiving and emotional encouragement, grounding, and perspective – for him, he wouldn’t be at the top of the leaderboard this weekend. In fact, he may not have been at the Houston Open at all, nor able to continue playing golf, without the things that Gabby sacrificed to care for him during what was presumably not only the moment his career was in jeopardy, but the moment when his health and his life were on the line.
